dataset.purpose: Frozen retrieval diagnostic set, separate from the eight tuning questions. Author-generated labels; same known synthetic corpus; no independent annotation or unseen-corpus claim.

methodology.scope: New author-labeled synthetic diagnostic questions, frozen before measuring; no parameter tuning.
methodology.limits: Same eight known documents; exact section labels, not independent human judgments. No answer generation or answer-quality claim.
methodology.pairing: Each mode shares the same dense and lexical candidates for each question/repeat. No retries or silent fallback.
methodology.latency: Component-derived, sequential production ordering: dense; dense+lexical+fusion; plus reranking. Excludes auth, routing, LLM, and network-to-API. Not independent end-to-end timings.
methodology.ranking: Actual top six chunks; duplicate section labels receive no extra relevance credit. All specified sections are required labels, not exhaustive judgments of all useful evidence.
methodology.intervals: 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of question clusters; repeats averaged per question. Exploratory, not multiple-comparison adjusted.

dataset_hash_method: Original pre-measurement Windows file bytes (CRLF); see dataset_normalized_sha256 for Git checkout validation
